description: This Java class 'FeaturesCreatedStrategy' handles the 'FeaturesCreated' event in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically within the persistence layer's actor strategies for handling events related to things. It extends an abstract class to implement event-specific logic for updating a 'ThingBuilder' with features from the event.

classes.name: FeaturesCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the 'FeaturesCreated' event by applying feature data to a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to update the 'ThingBuilder' with features from the 'FeaturesCreated' event.
